name: Deftones

whyMatters.en: Sacramento band formed in 1988. Nu-metal rhythm weight with shoegaze guitar wash; White Pony (2000) sits between metal festival bills and indie playlists.
whyMatters.zh: 萨克拉门托乐队，1988 年成立。Nu-metal 节奏重量配合 shoegaze 吉他铺底；White Pony（2000）处于金属音乐节账单与 indie 播放列表之间。

lyricQuotes: I dig through the ditches / And burn through the witches
I felt this coming from miles away

shortBio.en: Moreno / Carpenter alt-metal; White Pony bridges metal radio and shoegaze texture.
shortBio.zh: Moreno / Carpenter 的 alt-metal；White Pony 连接 metal 电台与 shoegaze 纹理。

body.en:
Formed in 1988 in Sacramento. Adrenaline and Around the Fur hit 1990s heavy radio. White Pony (2000) widened the palette—trip-hop tempos, layered vocals, Carpenter’s low tunings against Moreno’s clean/scream split.

Change (In the House of Flies) is the main crossover single. Later records keep both audiences: metal festival stages and indie/shoegaze playlists.
body.zh:
1988 年于萨克拉门托组建。Adrenaline 与 Around the Fur 打进 1990 年代 heavy 电台。White Pony（2000）拓宽调色板——trip-hop 速度、多层人声、Carpenter 降调对 Moreno 清唱/嘶吼分工。

Change (In the House of Flies) 是主要跨界单曲。后期作品仍维持双观众：金属音乐节与 indie/shoegaze 播放列表。

note.en: Around the Fur; down-tuned riff and Moreno scream on metal radio.
note.zh: Around the Fur；降调 riff 与 Moreno 嘶吼打进 metal 电台。

note.en: White Pony crossover; delay-wash guitars and mid-tempo groove.
note.zh: White Pony 跨界；延时铺底吉他与中速 groove。

note.en: Trip-hop tempo and layered vocal; atmosphere over riff speed.
note.zh: Trip-hop 速度与多层人声；氛围优先于 riff 速度。

title.zh: Nu-metal 重量加 shoegaze 铺底

body.en:
Around the Fur (1997) kept Sacramento on Ozzfest bills. White Pony (2000) added Delgado’s samples and delay-heavy guitars—Change and Digital Bath crossed to alternative radio.

Carpenter’s seven-string sludge and Moreno’s falsetto sit in one mix without pop polish.
body.zh:
Around the Fur（1997）把萨克拉门托送上 Ozzfest。White Pony（2000）加入 Delgado 采样与延时重型吉他——Change 与 Digital Bath 跨界 alternative 电台。

Carpenter 七弦 sludge 与 Moreno 假声共处一混音，无 pop 抛光。

title.zh: 核心四人加 Delgado 纹理

body.en:
Moreno, Carpenter, and Cunningham are constant since 1988. Chi Cheng held bass through White Pony; Sergio Vega filled after 2009. Delgado joined in 1999 on turntables/samples—fifth voice on White Pony.

Peak citation is the White Pony five-piece before Cheng’s 2008 accident.
body.zh:
Moreno、Carpenter、Cunningham 自 1988 起不变。Chi Cheng 守贝斯至 White Pony；2009 后 Sergio Vega 补位。Delgado 1999 年以转盘/采样加入——White Pony 的第五声部。

引用峰值是 Cheng 2008 事故前的 White Pony 五人组。

title.zh: 2000 年代 alt-metal 里的氛围

body.en:
My Bloody Valentine and Sonic Youth supply the wash; Soundgarden and Tool supply the riff weight. Linkin Park shared radio space with more hook-first writing; Deftones kept slow-build texture.

Influence shows in bands that use delay guitars and clean/scream splits without full nu-metal cadence.
body.zh:
My Bloody Valentine 与 Sonic Youth 提供铺底；Soundgarden 与 Tool 提供 riff 重量。Linkin Park 共享电台，写法更 hook 优先；Deftones 守住慢铺纹理。

影响体现在使用延时吉他与清唱/嘶吼分工、但不抄完整 nu-metal 腔调的乐队上。

interviewQuotes.text: We're not nu-metal. We just got filed next to it.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Chino Moreno

interviewQuotes.text: The heavy parts and the pretty parts have to live in the same song.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Stephen Carpenter
